subject: BUG FIX: tier-mid blue 2.09:1 FAIL - replace with #4A90D9 on dark
body:
BUG FIX SPEC: tier-mid blue contrast failure on dashboard
Filed by: GD after Pistons palette WCAG audit

BUG
.std-card.tier-mid .std-pct uses --accent-blue (#1D42BA) as text color.
#1D42BA on #161b22 (fd-card bg) = 2.09:1. Fails WCAG AA for both normal text AND non-text (needs 3:1 min for graphical elements, 4.5:1 for normal text).
Impact: Standards mastery percentages in the 70-89% range show in unreadable blue.

FIX
Add a new CSS variable --accent-blue-on-dark for use on dark backgrounds.
Value: #4A90D9 (contrast on #161b22 = 5.18:1 PASS, on #0d1117 = 5.73:1 PASS).
This is Pistons-blue-adjacent, same hue, brightness lifted to pass contrast.
--accent-blue (#1D42BA) stays unchanged for light-mode use on white (8.27:1 PASS).

IMPLEMENTATION — index.html only
1. Add to :root block or inline style in index.html:
   --accent-blue-on-dark: #4A90D9;

2. Change .std-card.tier-mid rules (lines ~108-110):
   FROM:
     .std-card.tier-mid { border-left-color: var(--accent-blue); }
     .std-card.tier-mid .std-pct { color: var(--accent-blue); }
     .std-card.tier-mid .std-fill { background: var(--accent-blue); }
   TO:
     .std-card.tier-mid { border-left-color: var(--accent-blue-on-dark); }
     .std-card.tier-mid .std-pct { color: var(--accent-blue-on-dark); }
     .std-card.tier-mid .std-fill { background: var(--accent-blue-on-dark); }

3. Optionally: add --accent-blue-on-dark to shared/styles.css :root block for future reuse.

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- tier-mid standards cards show percentage in readable blue
- Contrast ratio >=4.5:1 on #161b22
- #1D42BA still used everywhere else (border-focus, chart line tkBlue, etc.)
- Visual: slightly lighter blue, same Pistons family, not jarring

Note: FD is being notified of this bug separately (Pistons palette WCAG audit report).
